skill_name: Describe the impact of the internet on the job market in the past 10 years
workflow: In the past decade, the internet has had a major impact on the job market. The emergence of the internet has enabled job seekers to access a much larger pool of available job opportunities than ever before. Additionally, employers have been able to adopt cost-efficient technologies for recruiting, on-boarding, and managing employees.
